title: OpenZFS Office Hours with Matt Ahrens
summary: An OpenZFS office hours session with ZFS co-creator Matt Ahrens answering questions on topics such as hole birth time, send/receive buffers, device removal, block pointer rewrite and performance with many snapshots.
why: Cited as the authoritative explanation of why block pointer rewrite is so hard to implement in ZFS.

quote.text: The above video is an explanation of a bunch of the barriers to implementing block pointer rewrites.
